allowed_work: manifest-bound Codex source research, planning, isolated preparation and independent review (nontraining)
forbidden_work: Tailscale, Windows OpenSSH, or WSL2 transport
required_before_research: worker status ready and usage_ok=true below 50 GiB
manifest includes relative paths, byte sizes, SHA-256, and cleanup
result return SHA-256 verified before scratch cleanup; recoverable interruptions preserve the latest complete checkpoint/completed shards

agent_research_policy.unavailable_action: skip remote dispatch and continue independent server research; no tight retries
agent_research_policy.applicable_gates: Economic/market work needs its existing full plan and iteration gates; source/plan/review work stays within its separately authorized preparation scope.

interruption_policy.availability: Owner may pause or power off at any time; calendar daytime is only a probability, not readiness.
interruption_policy.state: Use native framework checkpoints and completed shards with fixed experiment configuration, seed and model/data versions.
interruption_policy.retention: Keep the latest complete checkpoint and completed shards under total C:\paseo/50GiB; retain the only valid checkpoint during a recoverable interruption.
interruption_policy.resume: After online and fresh ready, inspect the old job/process/output. Use native resume if supported, otherwise same-definition rerun or continue completed shards.
interruption_policy.accounting: Retain cumulative time, cost, model fits/optimizer updates and trial exposure; no quota reset by renaming or rerunning.
interruption_policy.cleanup: Only after verified return/completion or explicit abandonment; do not mechanically remove the only unreturned checkpoint.
limits: No complex recovery system or new daemon
Disconnection does not prove checkpoint or stop succeeded
